import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Hungary {
        static final int SIZE = 2000;
        int cnt;
        int[] pos = new int[SIZE];
        int[] rev = new int[SIZE];
        int[] v = new int[SIZE];
        
        int gao(int n, List<Integer>[] e) {
            cnt = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pos, -1);
            Arrays.fill(rev, -1);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(v, 0);
                if (match(i, e)) cnt++;
            }
            return cnt;
        }
        
        private boolean match(int x, List<Integer>[] e) {
            for (int i = 0; i < e[x].size(); i++) {
                int y = e[x].get(i);
                if (v[y] != 0) continue;
                v[y] = 1;
                if (rev[y] < 0 || match(rev[y], e)) {
                    pos[x] = y;
                    rev[y] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int[] dr = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dc = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static int[][] gridA = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] gridB = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] dist = new int[12][12];
    static int rows, timeLimit;
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[2000];
    static List<Integer>[][] exits = new List[12][12];

    static void bfs(int sr, int sc) {
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        qr.add(sr);
        qc.add(sc);
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            sr = qr.poll();
            sc = qc.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nr = sr + dr[i], nc = sc + dc[i];
                if (gridA[nr][nc] >= 0 && dist[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[sr][sc] + 1;
                    qr.add(nr);
                    qc.add(nc);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void propagate(int sr, int sc, int count) {
        int[][] visited = new int[12][12];
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                visited[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        qr.add(sr);
        qc.add(sc);
        visited[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            sr = qr.poll();
            sc = qc.poll();
            if (visited[sr][sc] > Math.min(timeLimit, dist[sr][sc])) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < exits[sr][sc].size(); j++) {
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    adj[rows + i].add(exits[sr][sc].get(j));
                }
            }
            if (visited[sr][sc] == Math.min(timeLimit, dist[sr][sc])) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nr = sr + dr[i], nc = sc + dc[i];
                if (gridA[nr][nc] >= 0 && visited[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    visited[nr][nc] = visited[sr][sc] + 1;
                    qr.add(nr);
                    qc.add(nc);
                }
            }
        }
        rows += count;
    }

    static Hungary solver = new Hungary();

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        timeLimit = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = -1;
                gridB[i][j] = -1;
                exits[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 2000; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        int startR = 0, startC = 0, idx = 0;
        rows = 0;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    gridA[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    startR = i;
                    startC = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        bfs(startR, startC);
        
        br.readLine();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    gridB[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < gridB[i][j]; k++) {
                    exits[i][j].add(idx++);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                if (dist[i][j] < 0) {
                    dist[i][j] = INF;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] > 0) {
                    propagate(i, j, gridA[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(solver.gao(rows, adj));
    }
}
